set.body:
Work key: L01.2
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Immediate target: docs/local-demo-plan.md
Accountable role: Product/backend/frontend engineer with local operator
Program scope: required

Scope: Provide packaged-service workstation tooling with isolated state and predictable lifecycle.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement install/check/start/status/stop commands using the pinned artifact and PostgreSQL image, private configuration, distinct migration/runtime roles and loopback-only ports; report the retained instance root without credentials.
2. Reject occupied ports, existing/unowned roots, invalid prerequisites and unsafe permissions before starting; preserve accepted data across stop/restart and avoid touching unrelated processes or volumes.
3. Provide an explicit demo-only reset guarded by instance identity and root ownership; qualify fresh install, repeated lifecycle commands and refusal to reset arbitrary paths.

Verification: Actual local install receipt with artifact/configuration/machine identity, private-file/port/privilege checks, restart hashes and guarded-reset negative cases.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/L01.2/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

References:
- docs/local-demo-plan.md
- docs/service-distribution.md
- docs/decisions/001-institutional-organization.md

Blocked by:
- L01.1: bd-01M4X5MA1AAA6MXNK2PWBAYYP1
- O01.4: bd-01M4W5P82ESVMAKQCP7FZ8DXP3

Completion rule: satisfy every criterion with observed, source-bound evidence. Local fixtures and engineering checks cannot replace institutional approval, real-provider qualification, human accessibility or operator acceptance. No external outreach is authorized by this task.
set.title: L01.2: Install and manage a retained local demonstration instance
